scenes.say: In spring Verstappen was threatening to quit Formula One. By summer he'd signed to twenty thirty.
A year ago in Qatar: if the new cars weren't fun, he'd leave.
In March at Suzuka he was eighth and called the racing anti-driving. Reports said he might quit at year end.
His deal ran to twenty twenty-eight, but with performance clauses that let him leave early.
In May in Canada: staying like this was mentally not doable. No changes for twenty twenty-seven, and he could go.
In June the FIA approved the tweaks: for twenty twenty-seven, more engine power and less from the battery.
On August twentieth, before Zandvoort, Red Bull extended his deal to the end of twenty thirty.
First win only in race sixteen, then Singapore and Mexico. He's second going into Vegas.
Follow how Max ends the season on LapRadar.

title: Verstappen threatened to quit F1, then signed to 2030: his 2026 timeline
